study: Garet et al. 2008, Early Reading PD (LETRS institutes +/- coaching), NCEE 2008-4030
delivery_evidence: Treatment A = 8 content-focused institute & seminar days (summer 2005 + school year); Treatment B adds ~60 hrs in-school coaching (3-day coaching institute + on-site follow-up trainings). All face-to-face (Ch.3 Teacher Institute Series & Coaching, pp.29-39).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcome = district standardized reading tests (TerraNova/CTBS in 4 districts, SAT-10 in 1, criterion-referenced state test in 1), broad independent assessments standardized within district (Table 4-3, p.51).
curriculum_evidence: Study deliberately enrolled schools already using one of two existing core reading programs; PD (LETRS, itself a PD curriculum) aimed to improve teachers' use of their existing reading program - no new student curriculum provided (footnote 6, p.~; Summary of PD Interventions).
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted effects = Implementation Year, Spring 2006 (end of the intervention year); follow-up Year (Spring 2007) exists but is not the primary extracted wave (Table 4-3, p.51; notes).
